description: Text for an ambush on the route.

reveal: Contacts on scanner near {destination}. They were waiting for you.
Three ships drop out of cruise ahead. Somebody sold your route.
aftermath: Someone talked. {client} swears it wasn't them.
The ambushers knew your cargo manifest. That's worth asking {client} about.

description: Text for discovering the cargo was stolen.

reveal: A port scan flags your {cargo} as stolen property. You are now wanted.
The {cargo} carries the serials of a convoy that went missing last week.
aftermath: {faction} won't be offering you work for a while.
You were the delivery, and also the scapegoat.
